title: Network-initiated de-registration procedure completion by the network

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to accept network-initiated de-registration.

entities.name: Timer T3522
entities.description: Timer used by the network during network-initiated de-registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for 3GPP access
entities.description: 5GMM state indicating the UE is de-registered for 3GPP access.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for non-3GPP access
entities.description: 5GMM state indicating the UE is de-registered for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access
entities.description: 5GMM state indicating the UE is de-registered for both 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

entities.name: De-registration request for 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where the de-registration request is specifically for 3GPP access.

entities.name: De-registration request for non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where the de-registration request is specifically for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: De-registration request for both 3GPP and non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where the de-registration request is for both 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

relations.description: Receipt of DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message stops timer T3522.
De-registration request for 3GPP access causes network to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for 3GPP access.
De-registration request for non-3GPP access causes network to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for non-3GPP access.
De-registration request for both access types causes network to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for both 3GPP and non-3GPP access.
